text: Nvidia became the first company in history to close above a $4 trillion market cap on July 9, 2025 [Source: ev-1]. This milestone was driven by strong demand for Blackwell accelerator GB200 and GB300 rack systems, as well as the Stargate project’s approximately $500 billion AI-infrastructure plan [Source: ev-1]. Additionally, major hyperscalers including Microsoft, Meta, Google, and Amazon repeatedly raised their capital expenditure guidance throughout 2025, while Nvidia maintained a dominant share of the AI-accelerator market [Source: ev-1]. CEO Jensen Huang framed this period as a transition from training to inference demand, describing it as "AI factories" selling compute as a commodity [Source: ev-1].
